Metallic Block Diagram of System (should be fitted) Detailed Lay Out Diagram of all sub units
The control panel & repeater panels are bulkhead mounted type , drip proof.
Panel should provide audio alarm including location
Para 13 of policy letter NB/0695/AFAS dated 24 Aug 21
Low Level — 0.3 Mtr above the deck
High Level — 01 Mtr above the deck
System Supply 230V AC, 1 Phase, 50/60 HZ (10% voltage variation).
Para 17 of policy letter NB/0695/AFAS dated 24 Aug 21.
System should be continuously powered and should have an automatic change over to stand by supply in case of failure of normal supply.
UPS back up for minimum 120 minutes
Interfacing with Battle Damage Control System (BDCS)/IPMS
Fault alarm (Indicating type of fault) indication
The Main control panel shall have provision for interfacing with a graphic based PC/ LCD front end to provide the ship's GA drawing as an underlay.
Separate indication with zone indication for each sensor (in case of more than one sensor in same compartment)
Audio and Visual alarm in case of flooding (within 04 Sec)

Facility to fit external hooter in crew accommodation, control station, service space, Machinery space to be provided in control panel. If a flood alarm is not acknowledged within two minutes after activation hooter must sound.
Password Protection — User control on the MCP shall be password protected.
In no alarm state all indications will be off, but power indication and health indication must glow.
Inbuilt Fault Diagnostic status scan at pre-defined interval.

System should have provision for self test. </br> 4.15.1 Indication of defect/ malfunction if any sensor. </br> 4.15.2 Short circuit in the system. </br> 4.15.3 Open circuit in the cable. </br> 4.15.4 Defect in any of the system subunits. </br> 4.15.5 Power Failure.
When 'Reset' push is operated, alarm and warning light is cleared. But if any fault is still present, that indication to be persisted.
Event Logging. Alarms, Faults and system status together with time are saved in system.
